<script type="text/javascript">/* global jQuery */

(function ($, document) {
    'use strict';

    $(function () {
        var $cultures = $('footer #dropdown-languages select');

        /**
         * Redirect the current page with selected lang-locale
         */
        function updateCulture() {
            var locale = '/' + $(this).val() + '/';
            var pathname = document.location.pathname;
            if (pathname.startsWith('/status')) {
                document.location.replace(locale + pathname.substring(1));
            } else {
                document.location = document.location.pathname.replace(/^\/[a-z]{2}-[a-z]{2}\//, locale); // eslint-disable-line
            }
        }

        $cultures.on('change', updateCulture);
    });
})(jQuery, window.document);

    <script type="text/javascript">(function ($, Core) {
    "use strict";

    /**
     * Utility functions used throughout the site for common tasks.
     *
     * @class Core.Util
     */
    Core.Util = (function () {

        window.isLocalStorageAvailable = undefined;

        return {

            /**
             * Encodes html attribute string.
             *
             * @param value The string to encode.
             * @return The encoded string.
             */
            EncodeAttribute: function (value) {
                return Core.Util.EncodeHtml(value).replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/'/g, "&apos;").replace(/`/g, "&#96;");
            },
            /**
             * Encodes html string.
             *
             * @param value The string to encode.
             * @return The encoded string.
             */
            EncodeHtml: function (value) {
                if (!value) {
                    return "";
                }
                return value.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;");
            },

            /**
             * Encodes string elements.
             * https://github.com/janl/mustache.js/blob/master/mustache.js#L53
             *
             * @param string Value to be encoded.
             */
            EscapeHtml: function (string) {
                var escapeMap = {
                    "&": "&amp;",
                    "<": "&lt;",
                    ">": "&gt;",
                    '"': "&quot;",
                    "'": "&#39;",
                    "/": "&#x2F;"
                };

                return string.replace(/[&<>"'\/]/g, function (element) {
                    return escapeMap[element];
                });
            },

            /**
             * Sanitizes a string by making lower-cased and trimmed.
             *
             * @param string Value to be sanitized.
             */
            SanitizeString: function (string) {
                return $.trim(string).toLowerCase();
            },

            /**
             * Appends to the URL, adding to the history if available,
             * otherwise refreshing the page.
             *
             * @param url Updated url.
             */
            SoftLoadUrl: function (state, title, url) {
                var current = window.location.href.split(window.location.host)[1];

                if (current !== url) {
                    if (window.history && window.history.pushState) {
                        window.history.pushState(state, title, url);
                        return true;
                    } else {
                        window.location = url;
                        return false;
                    }
                }
            },

            /**
             * Accepts pairs key value pairs of query string params
             * Soft loads them using SoftLoadUrl
             *
             * @param kvPairs pairs of query string params
             */
            SoftLoadQueryStringPairs: function (kvPairs) {
                var qs = Core.Util.GetQueryStringFromPairs(kvPairs);
                if (qs !== window.location.search) {
                    return Core.Util.SoftLoadUrl(null, null, location.href.split("?")[0] + qs);
                } else {
                    return true;
                }
            },

            /**
             * Updates a given query string with a given name and value
             *
             * @param qs The whole querystring
             * @param name the name of the query string parameter
             * @param value the value of the query string parameter
             */
            UpdateQueryString: function (qs, name, value) {
                if (value && value !== null) {
                    value = value.toString();
                    var match = RegExp("[?&]" + name + "=([^&]*)", 'gi').exec(qs);
                    if (match !== null) {
                        return qs.replace(new RegExp("([?&]" + name + "=)([^&]*)", 'gi'), "$1" + value.replace(/ /g, "+"));
                    } else {
                        var param = (qs.length > 0 ? "&" : "?");
                        param += name + "=" + value.replace(/ /g, "+");
                        return qs + param;
                    }
                } else {
                    /* remove parameter if value null */
                    qs = qs.replace(new RegExp("([?&]" + name + "=)([^&]*)"), "");
                    if (qs[0] === "&") {
                        qs = "?" + qs.slice(1);
                    }

                    return qs;
                }
            },

            /**
             * Extracts a value of a query string pair from the name
             *
             * @param name the key of the query string pair
             */
            GetParameterByName: function (name) {
                var match = RegExp("[?&]" + name + "=([^&]*)").exec(window.location.search);
                return match && decodeURIComponent(match[1].replace(/\+/g, " "));
            },

            /**
             * Extracts a query string from given pairs and the current query string
             *
             * @param kvPairs The set of query string pairs
             */
            GetQueryStringFromPairs: function (kvPairs) {
                var qs = location.search;
                $.each(kvPairs, function (k, v) {
                    qs = Core.Util.UpdateQueryString(qs, k, v);
                });

                return qs;
            },

            /**
             * Sets a cookie
             *
             * @param key The cookie key
             * @param value The cookie value
             * @param expire The cookie expiration date
             */
            SetCookie: function (key, value, expire) {
                var expiresDefault = 365;

                if (!expire || typeof expire !== "number") {
                    expire = expiresDefault;
                }

                if (key && value) {
                    $.cookie(key, value, { expires: expire, path: "/" });
                    return true;
                } else {
                    return false;
                }
            },

            /**
             * Gets a cookie
             *
             * @param key The cookie key
             */
            GetCookie: function (key) {
                return $.cookie(key);
            },

            /**
             * Sets a key value pair in localStorage
             *
             * @param key The stored key
             * @param value The stored value
             */
            SetStorage: function (key, value) {
                if (window.localStorage && Core.Util.CheckLocalStorageavailability()) {
                    try {
                        localStorage.setItem(key, value);
                    } catch (err) {
                        Core.Util.TrackException('Error to set value to local storage, key is "' + key + '", value is :"' + value + '", err is : ' + JSON.stringify(err) + '.');
                    }
                }
            },
            /**
             * Checking if local storage can set value.
             * Should help to catch issue with Safari private mode.
             */
            CheckLocalStorageavailability: function () {
                if (!window.localStorage) {
                    window.isLocalStorageAvailable = false;
                } else if (typeof window.isLocalStorageAvailable === 'undefined') {
                    try {
                        localStorage.setItem('azure-test', 'test');

                        localStorage.removeItem('azure-test');

                        window.isLocalStorageAvailable = true;
                    } catch (err) {
                        window.isLocalStorageAvailable = false;
                    }
                }

                return window.isLocalStorageAvailable;
            },

            /**
             * Gets a value from localStorage
             *
             * @param key The stored key
             */
            GetStorage: function (key) {
                var result = null;
                if (window.localStorage && Core.Util.CheckLocalStorageavailability()) {
                    var result = null;
                    try {
                        result = localStorage.getItem(key);
                        return result;
                    } catch (err) {
                        Core.Util.TrackException('Error to get value by key from local storage, key is "' + key + '", err is : ' + JSON.stringify(err) + '.');
                    }
                }

                return result;
            },

            /**
             * Removes a key from localStorage
             *
             * @param key The stored key
             */
            RemoveStorage: function (key) {
                if (window.localStorage && Core.Util.CheckLocalStorageavailability()) {
                    try {
                        localStorage.removeItem(key);

                        return true;
                    } catch (ex) {
                        Core.Util.TrackException('Error to remove key from local storage, key is "' + key + '", err is : ' + JSON.stringify(err) + '.');
                        return false;
                    }
                }
            },

            /**
             * Convert a string to lowercase, and replace non-slug characters with dashes
             */
            Sluggify: function (string) {
                return string.replace(/[,. :]/g, '-').toLowerCase();
            },

            /**
             * Format a string replacing placeholders such as {0}, {1}, etc. by the provided values
             */
            FormatString: function () {
                var s = arguments[0];
                for (var i = 0; i < arguments.length - 1; i++) {
                    var reg = new RegExp("\\{" + i + "\\}", "gm");
                    s = s.replace(reg, arguments[i + 1]);
                }

                return s;
            },

            /**
             * Track exception using Application Insight
             */

            TrackException: function (msg) {
                if (window.appInsights) { // eslint-disable-line
                    var schemaError = new Error(msg);

                    window.appInsights.trackException(schemaError);
                }
            }
        };
    })();

})(jQuery, Core);

    <script type="text/javascript">/* global jQuery, Acom */

(function ($, global, Core) {
    var $body = $('body'),
        $zoneTabs = $('.zone'),
        $zonetabsa = $('.zone a'),
        $azureHeader = $('#azure-header'),
        zoneQueryString = "", //qs2object(global.location.search).zone,
        $refreshDropdown = $('#refresh'),
        pagination = $('[data-control="pagination"]'),
        paginationPageSize = 10,
        $historyErrorMessage = $('#history-error-message'),
        historyPageNumber = 1,
        historyRegion = 'all',
        historyService = 'all',
        historyDate = 'recent',
        historyContainer = $('#history-results-container'),
        dropdownHistoryRegion = $('#wa-dropdown-history-region'),
        dropdownHistoryService = $('#wa-dropdown-service'),
        dropdownHistoryDate = $('#wa-dropdown-date'),
        MENU_RESIZE_EVENT = 'menuResize',
        timer,
        statusRegionItem = Core.Util.GetStorage('status-region'),
        statusRefreshItem = Core.Util.GetStorage('statusRefresh');

    if (global.location.hash === '#history') {
        global.location = global.location.pathname + 'history/'; // eslint-disable-line no-param-reassign
    }

    function changeRefresh(time) {
        Core.Util.SetStorage('statusRefresh', time);

        if ($refreshDropdown.length > 0) {
            window.clearTimeout(timer);
            timer = window.setTimeout(function () {
                window.location = window.location;
            }, time);
        }
    }

    function updateZone(zone) {
        var currentZone = zone || 'current-impact';

        Core.Util.SetStorage('status-region', currentZone);

        // hide and show appropriate tables
        $('.status-table').css('display', 'none').removeClass('active');
        $('.status-table[data-zone-name="' + currentZone + '"]').addClass('active').not('.fixed-status-header').css('display', 'table');


        // update the active tab
        $zoneTabs.removeClass('active');
        $zonetabsa.attr('aria-selected', 'false');
        $('.zone[data-zone-name="' + currentZone + '"]').addClass('active');
        $('.zone[data-zone-name="' + currentZone + '"] a').attr('aria-selected', 'true');
    }

    // check for filtered results based on query string or local storage else default to first zone
    if (zoneQueryString) {
        updateZone(zoneQueryString);
    } else if (statusRegionItem) {
        updateZone(statusRegionItem);
    } else {
        updateZone($zoneTabs.first().data('zone-name'));
    }

    // event listeners
    $body.on('click', '.zone', function (e) {
        updateZone($(this).data('zone-name'));
        e.preventDefault();
    });

    $body.on(MENU_RESIZE_EVENT, function () {
        var $activeHeader = $('.fixed-status-header.active');

        if ($azureHeader.hasClass('collapsed')) {
            $activeHeader.css('top', '42px');
        } else {
            $activeHeader.css('top', '84px');
        }
    });

    // if there are zones with issues, show the first tab with impacted regions and services
    if ($('.zone.impacted').length > 0) {
        $('.zone.impacted').eq(0).trigger('click');
    }

    // get and set page refresh time in local storage and dropdown,
    if (statusRefreshItem && typeof statusRefreshItem === 'number' && !isNaN(statusRefreshItem)) { // eslint-disable-line
        $refreshDropdown.find('option[value="' + statusRefreshItem + '"]').attr('selected', 'selected');
        changeRefresh(statusRefreshItem);
    } else {
        changeRefresh($refreshDropdown.val());
    }

    $refreshDropdown.on('change', function () {
        changeRefresh($(this).find('option:selected').val());
    });


    // fixed table header global.sd.breakpoints.LARGE = 960
    function fixTableHeader() {
        var $activeHeader = $('.fixed-status-header.active');

        if ($('.region-status-table:visible').length > 0) {
            if ($(global).scrollTop() > $('.region-status-table:visible .status-table-head').offset().top - $azureHeader.height()) {
                if ($(global).width() > 960) {
                    $activeHeader.css('display', 'table');
                }
            } else {
                $activeHeader.css('display', 'none');
            }
        }
    }

    $(global).on('scroll', fixTableHeader);
    $(global).trigger('resize');

    // get it started!
    updateZone($('.zone.active').data('zone-name'));

 /** Start History **/

    function renderHistoryResultsError() {
        historyContainer.html('');
        $historyErrorMessage.attr('aria-hidden', false).removeClass('hide');
    }

    /** Results success callback */
    function renderHistoryResultsSuccess(data) {
        if (data && data.length > 0) {
            historyContainer.html(data);
            $historyErrorMessage.attr('aria-hidden', true).addClass('hide');
            paginate(); // eslint-disable-line no-use-before-define
        } else {
            renderHistoryResultsError();
        }

        if (historyDate === 'recent') {
            pagination.hide();
        } else {
            pagination.show();
        }
    }

    /** Ajax call to get fresh results */
    function renderHistoryResults() {
        historyContainer.html('').html('<div class="wa-loader"></div>');
        Acom.Util.Render.StatusHistoryResults(historyService, historyRegion, historyDate, historyPageNumber, renderHistoryResultsSuccess, renderHistoryResultsError);
    }

    // history page functionality
    function updatePage(e, page) {
        historyPageNumber = page;
        renderHistoryResults();
    }

    function paginate() {
        pagination.off('paged.pagination');
        pagination.data({ items: $('.wa-historyResult-count').val(), pagesize: paginationPageSize }).trigger('page.pagination', historyPageNumber);
        pagination.on('paged.pagination', updatePage);
    }

    /** Results error callback */

    /** Updates the region selection for history filtering */
    function changeHistoryRegion() {
        historyRegion = this.value;
        historyPageNumber = 1;
        renderHistoryResults();
    }

    /** Updates the service selection for history filtering */
    function changeHistoryService() {
        historyService = this.value;
        historyPageNumber = 1;
        renderHistoryResults();
    }

    /** Updates the service selection for history filtering */
    function changeHistoryDate() {
        historyDate = this.value;
        historyPageNumber = 1;
        renderHistoryResults();
    }

    // History Tab
    dropdownHistoryRegion.on('change', changeHistoryRegion);
    dropdownHistoryService.on('change', changeHistoryService);
    dropdownHistoryDate.on('change', changeHistoryDate);

    // Toggle status history card chevron
    $('.incident-history-header').click(function () {
        $(this).find('.chevron-down, .chevron-up').toggle();
    });

 /** End History **/
})(jQuery, window, window.Core);
